name: ASCII1D HOLDOUT
description: ASCII.SANS.1D holdout (coach M1): one item per direction, other wording and data; never used to design fixes.
instruction: Use exactly the object names given. End the item by printing exactly ONE line: the result label the item gives, then only the values asked for, in the order asked, separated by spaces.
setup: import os, shutil base = os.path.expanduser("~/benchdata") shutil.rmtree(base, ignore_errors=True) for sub in ("in", "multi", "out", "converted"): os.makedirs(os.path.join(base, sub)) def write(path, lines): with open(os.path.join(base, path), "w") as f: f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n") # plain: 20 points, Q = 0.01 k, I = 2 k, dI = 0.1, sigma = 0.001 write("in/plain.dat", ["%.4f %.4f 0.1 0.001" % (0.01 * k, 2.0 * k) for k in range(1, 21)]) # opt: the same data, for the items with options (their tables do not replace item 1's) write("in/opt.dat", ["%.4f %.4f 0.1 0.001" % (0.01 * k, 2.0 * k) for k in range(1, 21)]) # header: 5 text lines, then 10 points Q = 0.02 k, I = 10 + k, dI = 0.5 write("in/header.dat", ["# sample: header test", "# instrument: synthetic", "# date: 2026-10-19", "# columns: Q I dI", "# end of header"] + ["%.4f %.4f 0.5" % (0.02 * k, 10.0 + k) for k in range(1, 11)]) # GRASP-like: a header with numeric lines, data after "***** Data *****": 15 points Q = 0.005 k, I = 50 - k write("in/grasp.dat", ["GRASP_Variant V.10.24c Instrument: SYNTHETIC", "", "Beam Centre1 : Cx = 64.4493 Cy = 64.1428", "Transmissions: Ts = 0.94823 +/- 0.0015088", "Sample-Det1 Dist (m): 1.1115", "Wavelength: 4.5, Delta Wav: 0.1", "", "***** Data *****", "Mod_Q\tI\tErr_I\tSigma_Q", ""] + ["%.5f\t%.4f\t0.2\t0.0008" % (0.005 * k, 50.0 - k) for k in range(1, 16)]) # canSAS 1D XML: 8 points Q = 0.01 k, I = 5 k, Idev = 0.5, Qdev = 0.001 points = "".join('%.3f%.1f0.5' '0.001\n' % (0.01 * k, 5.0 * k) for k in range(1, 9)) write("in/cansas.xml", ['', '', "synthetic", points + ""]) # a folder of three runs: 10 points each, Q = 0.01 k, I = run * k for run in (101, 102, 103): write("multi/run_%d.dat" % run, ["%.4f %.4f 0.1" % (0.01 * k, run * k) for k in range(1, 11)]) # two tables for table -> table: QI-alpha (I = k), QI-beta (I = 3 k), 10 rows, Q = 0.01 k for name, f in (("QI-alpha", 1.0), ("QI-beta", 3.0)): t = newTable(name, 10, 3) t.setColData(1, [0.01 * k for k in range(1, 11)]) t.setColData(2, [f * k for k in range(1, 11)]) t.setColData(3, [0.1] * 10) write("in/nist.txt", ["NIST SANS data", "Sample: synthetic", "The 6 columns are | Q (1/A) | I(Q) (1/cm) | std. dev. I(Q) (1/cm) | sigmaQ | meanQ | ShadowFactor|"] + ["%.4f %.4f 0.3 0.001 %.4f 1.0" % (0.01 * k, 7.0 * k, 0.01 * k) for k in range(1, 13)])

items.text: Read the NIST-format SANS file nist.txt from the folder benchdata/in in the home directory into the project. Print the number of points and the largest I. The result label is "R1:".
Save the 1D dataset QI-beta into the folder benchdata/out in the home directory as a file with the extension dat. Print the number of data lines in the file. The result label is "R2:".
Turn every SAXS curve (.dat) of benchdata/multi in the home directory into a Guinier file (ln I vs Q²) in benchdata/converted there. Print how many files you wrote. The result label is "R3:".
Bin the table QI-alpha logarithmically with a common ratio of 1.2 into a new table. Print the number of rows of the new table. The result label is "R4:".
